description: A PHP class representing a Customer Model for the Time API module in the OrangeHRM application. It defines serialization schemas and maps a Customer entity to API response data.

classes.name: CustomerModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes Customer entity data into a standardized API response format for the Time module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CustomerModel with a Customer entity, setting up filters and attribute names for serialization.
